title: Combination Fudge
description: A confection made with coffee sugar, walnuts, and chocolate.

ingredients.name: butter size of a small egg

steps: In one pan put 3 cups coffee sugar and 1 cup milk, boil until it forms a soft ball in water
Add 1 teaspoon butter and let boil up
Take from the fire and allow it to cool so the hand may rest upon it
Beat with a spoon, adding after it begins to thicken 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 cup broken English walnuts
In another pan put 2 cups granulated sugar, 3/4 cup milk, 1 square unsweetened chocolate
Cook 8 minutes, then add butter size of a small egg
When it makes a firm ball in water take from the fire and add a few drops of vanilla
Beat until like very cold molasses, then pour into the pan that contains the other fudge
It will harden over the other and can be cut in squares

title: Curried Chicken
description: Prepared with chicken, onions, and curry powder.

ingredients.name: chicken weighing from a pound and a half to two pounds

steps: Cut up a chicken weighing from a pound and a half to two pounds, as for fricassee, wash it well, and put it in a stewpan with sufficient water to cover it.
Boil it closely covered, until tender; add a large teaspoonful of salt, and cook a few minutes longer.
Remove from the fire, take out the chicken, pour the liquor into a bowl, and set it one side.
Cut up into the stewpan two small onions, and fry them with a piece of butter as large as an egg.
As soon as the onions are brown, skim them out and put in the chicken; fry for three or four minutes.
Sprinkle over two teaspoonfuls of curry powder.
Pour over the liquor in which the chicken was stewed, stir all well together, and stew for five minutes longer.
Stir into this a tablespoonful of sifted flour made thin with a little water.
Lastly, stir in a beaten yolk of egg.
Serve with hot boiled rice laid round on the edge of a platter, and the chicken curry in the centre.

description: A pudding made with cream or milk, bitter almonds, and whites of eggs.

ingredients.name: 1 quart of cream or rich milk

Butter a large bowl or mould; pour in the mixture; tie a cloth tightly over it; put it into a pot of boiling water, and boil it two hours, replenishing the pot with hot water from a tea-kettle.
